title: maint.event.v1{kind=maint_clock_source_changed}
description: Phase 8 §8.15.1 — emitted at agent boot (resolved clock source) and on each detected container-suspend event. `action` distinguishes the two cases: omitted/null means boot validation; 'suspend_detected' means a suspend gap was observed between heartbeat ticks.

target.description: Agent ID reporting the clock source (e.g. 'maint.scaler.v1').

action.description: Null (or absent) = boot validation event. 'suspend_detected' = suspend gap detected during heartbeat.

prev.description: Clock source in previous process lifetime (null on first boot or unknown).

current.description: Resolved clock source for this process lifetime.

suspend_resilient.description: True if CLOCK_BOOTTIME is active (windows survive container suspend).

gap_s.description: Suspend gap in seconds (present only when action=suspend_detected).

recovered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the suspend gap was detected.
